title: 第7章 锻体七重巅峰第8章 战阎息
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第七章锻体七重巅峰
“倒是要谢谢这所谓的保护期。”
方羽轻笑着自语道。
这一个月的时间，对他来说至关重要，短短一个月的时间，他的修为从之前的锻体四重，已然提升到了锻体七重巅峰。
而且利用悟境，这一个月时间，他已然将龙拳第一式亢龙有悔，修炼至圆满。
当初锻体四重的时候，他施展入门的亢龙有悔，就能够发挥出锻体六重初期的战力。
如今方羽也很想知道，自己锻体七重巅峰的修为，配合圆满的亢龙有悔，战力能够达到什么层次。
方羽站起身来，走出茅屋。
刚走出茅屋，来到矿坑中央的广场上，方羽就感受到一道道充满戏谑的目光。
远处阎息看着自茅屋出来的方羽，眼中露出一丝精光。
“似乎有些不一样了，看来这罪子真的没有传言的那般简单，不过如今一个月过去了，你也该上路了。”
阎息低声自语道。
在其余几个角落，这九号矿坑的另外四位王者，此时也看着方羽。
几人眼中都露出了不一样的神色。
方羽感受到周围的目光，淡然的朝前走去，在来到矿坑入口处，方羽抬头朝阎息的方向看了一眼。
正好目光和阎息的目光对视在了一起。
两人对视，阎息看着方羽，轻轻一笑。
方羽看着阎息脸上的笑容，心中升起一股寒意。
在这九号矿坑待了一个月，方羽也知道了许多。
宁惹四王，莫惹阎王。
阎息在五王中，心机最深，行事也异常的阴毒狠辣。
就连同为五王的山王西门山，鬼王鬼泣，寒王李天寒，蓝王蓝凯，四人都对阎王阎息忌惮三分。
不过如今方羽经过这一个月时间的缓冲，已然无惧阎息。
以他锻体七重巅峰的修为，真的对上阎息，就算不是对手，方羽自信也有自保之力。
周围众多矿奴陆续进入矿坑之中。
在方羽要进入的时候，却被那守护矿坑的护卫拦了下来。
“你的一个月保护期已过，从今日份额暂时从之前的二十块下品青灵石，提升到五十块，今日出了矿坑之后，到事务堂那测试修为，根据修为再确定你每日要上缴的份额。”
护卫面无表情的开口说道。
方羽听到之后微微颔首。
这些他其实都已然了然。
进入矿坑之中，方羽随着人流不断下行。
很快就来到了第一层，方羽没有停止，依旧不断下行。
走在昏暗的甬道中，方羽能够感受到前后有几道目光正暗自打量着他。
方羽不以为意，依旧不断下行，很快就来到了第三层的位置。
方羽站在第三层驻足了半响之后，随后直接朝着第四层的方向走去。
他已经在第三层停留了十日，这里的青灵石虽然还有很多，但是以他如今的修为，他想去更下一层试试，随着不断深入，他相信青灵石会更加密集。
“他这是要去第四层？他不是找死吧？第四层的寒气比之第三层强了一倍不止，只有锻体八重以上的强者，才能够进入，难道这罪子真的有所隐藏？”
在后方一处阴暗的角落，其中一位中年男子，看着方羽的背影，眼中精光一闪，随后低声自语道。
半响之后，他看到方羽身形消失。

Chapter 7 The seventh level of body training
"I would like to thank you for this so-called protection period."
Fang Yu chuckled and said to himself.
This month is crucial to him. In just one month, his cultivation level has risen from the previous fourth level of body training to the peak of the seventh level of body training.
And using the enlightenment state, in this month, he has perfected the first form of Dragon Fist, "Dragon Fist".
When he was at the fourth level of body training, he used the introductory skill Kang Long Yougui, and he was able to exert his initial combat power at the sixth level of body training.
Now Fang Yu also wants to know what level of combat power he can reach with his cultivation at the seventh level of body training, combined with the perfect Kang Long Yougui.
Fang Yu stood up and walked out of the hut.
As soon as he walked out of the hut and came to the square in the center of the mine, Fang Yu felt a series of playful eyes.
Yan Xi looked at Fang Yu coming out of the hut from a distance, with a glint in his eyes.
"It seems a little different. It seems that this crime is not as simple as the rumors. But now that a month has passed, it's time for you to get on your way."
Yan Xi whispered to himself.
In the remaining corners, the other four kings of Mine No. 9 were also looking at Fang Yu.
Several people had different looks in their eyes.
Fang Yu felt the gazes around him and walked forward calmly. When he came to the entrance of the mine, Fang Yu raised his head and glanced in the direction of Yan Xi.
It happened that their eyes met Yan Xi's.
The two looked at each other, Yan Xi looked at Fang Yu and smiled softly.
Fang Yu looked at the smile on Yan Xi's face, and felt a chill in his heart.
After staying in Mine No. 9 for a month, Fang Yu also learned a lot.
It is better to provoke the Four Kings than the King of Hell.
Among the five kings, Yan Xi is the most scheming, and his actions are extremely vicious and cruel.
Even the Five Kings, Mountain King Ximen Shan, Ghost King Guiwei, Cold King Li Tianhan, and Blue King Lan Kai, all four of them are extremely afraid of the King of Hell, Yan Xi.
But now, after a month of buffering, Fang Yu is no longer afraid of Yan Xi.
With his cultivation at the seventh level of body training, if he really faced Yan Xi, even if he was not his opponent, Fang Yu was confident that he would be able to protect himself.
Many mining slaves around them entered the mine one after another.
When Fang Yu was about to enter, he was stopped by the guard guarding the mine.
"Your one-month protection period has expired. Today's share has been temporarily increased from the previous 20 yuan of low-grade blue spirit stones to 50 yuan. After leaving the mine today, go to the affairs hall to test your cultivation. Based on your cultivation, your daily share will be determined."
The guard said expressionlessly.
Fang Yu nodded slightly after hearing this.
He actually knew all of this.
Entering the mine, Fang Yu continued to descend with the flow of people.
Soon he arrived at the first floor. Fang Yu did not stop and continued to descend.
Walking in the dim corridor, Fang Yu could feel several eyes in front and behind him secretly sizing him up.
Fang Yu didn't take it seriously and kept going down, and soon reached the third floor.
Fang Yu stood on the third floor for a while, then walked directly towards the fourth floor.
He has stayed on the third level for ten days. Although there are still a lot of Qingling Stones here, with his current cultivation level, he wants to try the next level. As he goes deeper, he believes that the Qingling Stones will become denser.
"Is he going to the fourth floor? Isn't he looking for death? The cold air on the fourth floor is more than twice as strong as on the third floor. Only strong men with the eighth level of body training or above can enter. Is this sinner really hiding something?"
In a dark corner at the back, one of the middle-aged men looked at Fang Yu's back, his eyes flashed, and then he whispered to himself.
After a while, he saw Fang Yu disappear.
